name: Clinical Applicability Guard

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: Clinical computation/intervention is applied outside supported patient context.
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Dose, interpretation, or recommendation inappropriate for patient context.

invariants.statement: Unsupported applicability context must block clinically consequential computation.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
